name: Hyman Cannabis Mini Eclair Preroll | Daytona Dreamin
description:
Twice infused. Twice enjoyed. Each Éclair blends premium flower (0.6g) with cold-cured, hash rosin (0.1g), then finishes strong with a glass tip and H2O brushing for a smooth, even burn. Built to taste better and burn smarter. — all for the perfect HY.

Strain Type: Indica

Flavors: Berry, Spicy, Creamy

Aromas: Fruity, Sweet, Earthy

Experience: Creative, Energizing, Giggly
